verify-env-change-unapproved.rule: A change of verify.environment that loosens it takes the owner's approval, and the suite runs only under the declaration qargi last accepted
verify-env-change-unapproved.why: a declaration edited by hand, or loosened without the owner, would make the suite run under a looser environment than the one approved
